transport: SSH, host key independently obtained from Azure VM Run Command
command:
set -eu
date -u
hostname
cat /etc/os-release | head -4
node -v
npm -v
git --version
nginx -v 2>&1
mysql --version
systemctl is-active week07-web nginx
nginx -t 2>&1
cat /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
ss -lnt | head -12
cd /opt/week07/book/frontend
sha256sum package-lock.json
